notes: warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "It's no secret that I love Stasis; so naturally, this being the first on the list is exciting! RotN Judgment trades out a few perks in each column to make some notable combos. There's the self-sustaining Headstone/Rimestealer, the classic Demolitionist/Adrenaline Junkie, or Paracausal Affinity with an easy-to-proc 20% damage buff. Stats are still a little lacking compared to other 140s in this slot, especially Stability, so be sure to prioritize a little extra there." Recommended MW: Stability or Range.

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Judgment has familiar 4th column perks in Opening Shot and Timed Payload, but the 3rd column perks have joined by Keep Away and Lone Wolf. I'm especially interested in obtaining a version rocking Keep Away and Opening Shot as both provide range and accuracy through the fight. As noted for PvE rolls, while this gun did get a little stat bump on re-release, it still is lacking in Stability (and Range in PvP). Focus on one or both stats and this gun should perform decently." Recommended MW: Range or Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 141 from 27 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/51wAzrVIRJRsBHGTMCLZ0n?si=fade7bb615184d3e) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a Stasis build. While adaptives lose out to double burst and precision HCs for pure damage output, Judgment offers the rare choice of sights rather than barrels, if that's your preference. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 44 Range equates to 29.94m ADS and 19.96m hipfire before damage falloff, 42 Stability is ×1.1371 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 55 Handling is 0.32s ready, 0.24s ADS and 0.35s stow speed, and 45 Reload Speed is a 2.65s reload. Recoil Direction is 95, and Zoom is 14, and Magazine size is 9 (max 14). You can use any of the sight perks that don't involve a malus to fill out the stats. In the magazine perk slot, we're looking for something that helps Reload Speed. For Stasis builds, Headstone in the first trait perk column generates a stasis crystal on a crit kill, to proc fragment effects. Paracausal Affinity in the second provides a ×1.2 damage boost following a darkness energy kill, and if you shatter a Headstone crystal while active, the AoE damage inherits this boost. The Crossing Over origin trait is a little strange, providing extra range and handling in the top half of the mag, and a damage boost in the bottom starting at ×1.015 at 50% and ×1.03 with your penultimate and last shot, while Gravity Well can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Stasis Shards or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Judgment got an upgrade going from Kinetic to Stasis. While now it competes with the very dominant and popular Eyasluna, both being from a dungeon makes the competition also even. Headstone also being in the third column gives Judgment a huge edge. Being able to rock a damage perk and Headstone elevate Judgement past Eyasluna, however, Eyasluna is also able to get Unrelenting for better health. To each their own, but that is what makes Destiny so great." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Judgment lost a little bit of its edge in the crucible. You can still get Slideshot and Opening Shot. It’s not that Judgment is bad, just that other weapons edged it out and 140’s aren’t exactly strong in this meta (for the first time in a while). Hitmark HCS, SteadyHand HCS, or FastDraw HCS are all great options and allow you to add some much needed stats and aim assist. I am surprised Bungie didn’t swap Judgment over to barrels. I guess hand cannon sights are easier than “sights” if that makes sense." Recommended MW: Range or Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 97 from 13 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4Uy7pfo5Thjtt2MF4vZitv?si=8e3adcb68d234006) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content, particularly with a Stasis subclass. Judgment is back in a new Stasis form, although the stats are showing its age. On the plus side, you do still have Sight perks rather than barrels to choose from - Fastdraw, Steadyhand and Truesight all help to round out stats nicely. You can help reload speed with the mag perk - Tactical Mag is the top pick, but Flared Magwell or even Alloy Mag can work too. It's very unusual to see Headstone in the first trait perk slot, creating crystals to synergise with the Stasis fragments. Timed Payload looks interesting, although splitting impact and explosive damage might not play well with Headstone. Alternatively Adrenaline Junkie, when procced, will mean any Headstone crystals you create will share the same damage buffs when shattered. The Crossing Over origin trait is useful all around for PvE, with bumps to range and handling in the top half of a magazine, and a small 3% damage boost at the bottom. Recommended MW: Range, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 25. PvE backup roll for end-game content. Very stiff competition in-slot from Fatebringer, Eyasluna and DFA, but there are a few trait combinations that help claim a spot in your Vault. Look to boost Handling and Stability with sight and mag, to help gunfeel (or maybe add a bullet or two). For end-game, particularly solo, content, it's difficult to top Demolitionist and Osmosis to give you an additional element to help break shields. Drops from the first (Phalanx Echo) encounter if you're looking to farm it. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with a damage boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Range] "Judgment is a difficult one to categorise. It has interesting potential, with some decent perk combinations, but after some time with it, I feel fairly sure its meant to just be used as a flinch machine with Timed Payload.
